subject: Personnel assurance evidence transfer — SOC 2 sample set for Acme Health
messages:
From: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@secureaudit.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request — personnel assurance samples

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Acme Health's audit team is preparing the SOC 2 vendorpack and has asked for a short sample set demonstrating personnel controls for onboarding/offboarding, background checks, and security training. Specifically they asked for: 

- Redacted examples of background check confirmations for 3 hires in the last 12 months
- Training completion roster (security & privacy) for Q3 2027
- The current onboarding/offboarding runbook (versioned) and the deprovisioning checklist used by IT

Can you confirm what we can share as a limited sample and an expected delivery date? We prefer a secure drive link and can accept redacted PDFs/CSV exports. If there are any approved redaction conventions you follow, please share.

Thanks,
Emily Ramos
Senior Auditor, SecureAudit LLC
emily.ramos@secureaudit.io
+1 415 555 0192

---
Note: this request is scoped to Acme Health's SOC 2 engagement, not a general data export.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@secureaudit.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — personnel assurance samples

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a scoped sample bundle with the following constraints: 

- Background checks will be redacted to remove PII (SSN, DOB) and replaced with verification stamps (name initials, check type, date, and verification ID).
- Training roster will be exported as a CSV with employee ID hashes (one-way salted hash), course IDs, completion timestamps, and attestations.
- Onboarding/offboarding runbook will be delivered as the current PDF with version header and the deprovisioning checklist exported as a separate document.

Proposed timeline: initial sample (redacted) by 2027-10-13 COB PST. If that works, I will coordinate transfer via a shared Drive folder with view-only links and provide a short manifest.

Cc'ing Marissa (HR) and Soojin (Security) to confirm redaction approach and sign off on the sample set.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 646 555 0120
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@secureaudit.io>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — personnel assurance samples

+1 on Rafael's plan. Notes from Security: 

- Redaction standard: keep employee initials + verification ID (format: RBK-XXXX), remove DOB/SSN, truncate addresses to ZIP only.
- For the training roster, we will include the course syllabus IDs and audit log extract showing completion with UTC timestamps. No attachments will include personal emails.
- We'll include a short attestation (signed PDF) from HR describing redaction process and retention windows.

I'll prepare the manifest and a one-page ingestion note for Acme's audit team explaining how logs correlate to the roster.

Soojin Lee
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Ramos <emily.ramos@secureaudit.io>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 evidence request — personnel assurance samples

Emily / team — taking ownership of the artifacts. I will produce: 

1) redacted-bg-checks.zip (3 PDFs, redaction applied per Soojin's standard)
2) training-roster-2027Q3.csv (hashed IDs + course completion rows)
3) onboard-offboard-playbook.pdf (v3.2, last updated 2027-06-30)
4) hr-attestation-soc2.pdf (signed)

We will upload the bundle to the secure Drive folder and share the view-only link. Can you confirm Acme's auditor access window? We typically grant view-only for 30 days. If they need longer, we can arrange a SharePoint transfer with NDA terms.

Marissa Cole
Sr. People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHIJ_acme-soc2-pack (view-only)
